what: frozen before the claim and the first launch of E146; nothing of E146 exists

heat.sus_law: die_window = min(trip, (1 - w) die_start + w (die_idle + c_steady (P_sus - P_idle)))

R2_clock_buys.text: E119's clock_x unchanged (used by reduce_e146.py): T600 the mean T of launches whose kernel clock is in [590, 610] MHz, T800 of those at or above 790 MHz, every kind pooled; at least 2 launches at 600 and 5 at 800, else from the fit T = C/f + M over 590-810 MHz.

R0_ties.text: every check of C (the host's reference over the whole K) exact or approx, in the smoke and in every run; the smoke's cycles per op at the launch's own clock within 50-250% of MS's at 800 MHz; L2 and D8 (E136's g2k and g4k, the same arm and binary) T800 within 2% of E136's measured T800, per format (a second session on the same card). A FAIL of the checks labels every other verdict.

R1_store_pair.text: THE STORE TERM, primary. L4 (a store every 128 ops) and L8 (every 256) have the same lines an op by the desk model (A 64, B 128, all from the L3); rho = T800(L8) / T800(L4). On the axis from MAB's rho (no store term) to MS's: h = (rho - rho_MAB) / (rho_MS - rho_MAB). THE STORE TERM if h >= 0.75; NO STORE TERM if h <= 0.25; BETWEEN otherwise; NEITHER if h < -0.5 or h > 1.5. Per format; fp32 primary. If L8's T800 is above MS's 24 MB bound (its A no longer held by the L3), R1 is UNRESOLVED and the pair L2/L4 (MS against MAB the same way) is read in its place.

R2_ladder.text: every ladder cell's T800 (L1-L8, D1-D8; launches at or above 790 MHz, every kind pooled) within 5% of MS's; the rms relative error of each model (M0, MS, MAB) over the 24 cells; the model with the lowest rms predicts the ladder best. And each cell's X within 0.03 of MS's.

R3_burst_power.text: every admitted ladder cell's burst board power at 800 MHz (p800_w, the first second's median) within 4 W of PS(800); the rms of PS and of P0 (E136's law with M0's time) over the cells; at or below the admission estimate + 1 W.

R4_store_energy.text: the store's energy, measured: on the pair L4/L8 (the same lines), eps_meas = (e(L8) - e(L4)) / (1/256 - 1/128) with e = (p800 - B(800)) T800 per kind and format; within a factor of two of the fitted eps (the same sign, 0.5-2x), per format and kind; a cell whose PS(800) sits on the floor B(800) for either shape is not scored (the model says only the floor there). And on D4/D8 (lines nearly the same) printed, not scored.

R5_fresh.text: THE FRESH SHAPE F6 (gemmL3x4x6, never run), predicted first: T800 within 5% of MS's (per format; M0 and MAB printed); X within 0.03; burst p800 within 4 W of PS(800) (zeros and random, every format); burst die_max within 3 C of die_start + 0.1445 (P_burst,S - 21.5); the two sustained runs (fp32 randn, int8 full): clock within 30 MHz of G2's, board W within 4 W of G2's, the window die within 3 C of E136's sustained law on G2's power.

R6_die.text: every burst's die_max within 3 C of die_start + 0.1445 (P_burst - 21.5) with PS's burst power at PS's burst clock; rms printed (and with P0's).

R7_kind.text: every cell's T at or above 790 MHz within 1% of its zeros' (same shape and format).

R8_passes.text: the unit of replication is the pass: each cell's T800 and p800 per pass; the pair ratios of R1 per pass; a verdict that holds in one pass and not the other is reported as such (no interval between sessions: one session).
